name: binja-agent-mcp
author: Kazuma Matsumoto (modified version of Binary Ninja MCP by fosdickio and CX330Blake)
description: An MCP server for Binary Ninja, built for LLM agents: selectable tool sets, bounded answers and authenticated localhost requests. Not affiliated with Vector 35.
longdescription: binja-agent-mcp is a modified version of Binary Ninja MCP by fosdickio and CX330Blake (https://github.com/fosdickio/binary_ninja_mcp), based on upstream v1.1.0 (commit d8a2709df69ff475d6be6366c2eec733663b008b). Modified by Kazuma Matsumoto between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-18. Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the upstream authors or Vector 35 Inc.
